fact_text: A new auto policy, reported as near final, cuts the sales tax on EVs to 1% and aims to lower EV prices, support local EV assembly and boost exports.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'HUBC BYD EPS Scenario | PPL Receivables | Midday Flash 10 Nov 2026' (YouTube, 2026-11-10)

fact_text: Under the auto policy, plug-in hybrids pay 9% sales tax while ordinary cars fall under an 18% rate, which the analyst expects to push assemblers such as Toyota and Honda toward EVs and hybrids.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'HUBC BYD EPS Scenario | PPL Receivables | Midday Flash 10 Nov 2026' (YouTube, 2026-11-10)

fact_text: The auto policy sets a five-year export target of 6 billion US dollars for automakers, with the analyst reading it as a medium- to long-term positive for local assemblers.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'HUBC BYD EPS Scenario | PPL Receivables | Midday Flash 10 Nov 2026' (YouTube, 2026-11-10)

fact_text: The 2027 export target for car makers as a group is about 256 million US dollars a year, which the analyst called very small against the 6 billion dollar five-year goal.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'HUBC BYD EPS Scenario | PPL Receivables | Midday Flash 10 Nov 2026' (YouTube, 2026-11-10)

fact_text: The analyst expects the auto policy to cut EV and small EV prices by about 22 percent, while cheaper EVs and lower tax may draw more public interest.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'HUBC BYD EPS Scenario | PPL Receivables | Midday Flash 10 Nov 2026' (YouTube, 2026-11-10)

fact_text: Hub Power is reported to be bringing BYD vehicles into its EV line, and the analyst sees the listed company as the route through which the auto policy reaches Hub Power.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'HUBC BYD EPS Scenario | PPL Receivables | Midday Flash 10 Nov 2026' (YouTube, 2026-11-10)

fact_text: In the analyst's scenario, selling about 1,500 BYD cars a month would add only about 5 to 9 rupees to Hub Power EPS, a diluted effect that the analyst did not quantify further.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'HUBC BYD EPS Scenario | PPL Receivables | Midday Flash 10 Nov 2026' (YouTube, 2026-11-10)

fact_text: Pakistan Petroleum reported first-quarter FY27 EPS of 9.26 rupees, with sales of 74 billion rupees against roughly 56 to 57 billion a year earlier.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'HUBC BYD EPS Scenario | PPL Receivables | Midday Flash 10 Nov 2026' (YouTube, 2026-11-10)

fact_text: Pakistan Petroleum sales in the first quarter of FY27 were about 74 billion rupees, up from roughly 56 to 57 billion rupees in the same quarter a year earlier.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'HUBC BYD EPS Scenario | PPL Receivables | Midday Flash 10 Nov 2026' (YouTube, 2026-11-10)

fact_text: Pakistan Petroleum collections from gas utility companies were about 93 percent in FY2025 and about 91 percent in FY2026, with the analyst calling the results good.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'HUBC BYD EPS Scenario | PPL Receivables | Midday Flash 10 Nov 2026' (YouTube, 2026-11-10)

fact_text: Pakistan Petroleum collections from gas utility companies were about 93 percent in FY2025, the year before the 91 percent level reported for FY2026.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'HUBC BYD EPS Scenario | PPL Receivables | Midday Flash 10 Nov 2026' (YouTube, 2026-11-10)

fact_text: Pakistan Petroleum is expensing exploration costs, which the analyst says could turn into cash flow later in the cycle.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'HUBC BYD EPS Scenario | PPL Receivables | Midday Flash 10 Nov 2026' (YouTube, 2026-11-10)

fact_text: Workers remittances to Pakistan were about 3.89 billion US dollars in October 2026, which the analyst described as a strong inflow.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'HUBC BYD EPS Scenario | PPL Receivables | Midday Flash 10 Nov 2026' (YouTube, 2026-11-10)

fact_text: Stronger remittances and debt-market inflows improved the position of foreign reserves, according to the analyst.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'HUBC BYD EPS Scenario | PPL Receivables | Midday Flash 10 Nov 2026' (YouTube, 2026-11-10)

fact_text: Lower global crude prices narrow the trade deficit and ease the external account, which the analyst expects to support the broader market.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'HUBC BYD EPS Scenario | PPL Receivables | Midday Flash 10 Nov 2026' (YouTube, 2026-11-10)

fact_text: The analyst sees falling oil prices as a positive for cement and steel shares, because lower energy costs help the sector's margins.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'HUBC BYD EPS Scenario | PPL Receivables | Midday Flash 10 Nov 2026' (YouTube, 2026-11-10)

fact_text: Mughal Steel posted somewhat better results at the close of FY26, according to the analyst.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'HUBC BYD EPS Scenario | PPL Receivables | Midday Flash 10 Nov 2026' (YouTube, 2026-11-10)

fact_text: The analyst says copper ingot exports from China could be a game changer for Mughal Steel, but the effect was not visible in the September quarter results.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'HUBC BYD EPS Scenario | PPL Receivables | Midday Flash 10 Nov 2026' (YouTube, 2026-11-10)

fact_text: Amreli Steels showed a modest rebound in its 2026 results, with the analyst naming it as a rebar producer that could benefit from more construction activity.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'HUBC BYD EPS Scenario | PPL Receivables | Midday Flash 10 Nov 2026' (YouTube, 2026-11-10)

fact_text: Fauji Cement is expected to pursue a merger with Falcon Cement, the former Attock Cement, during FY2027, which the analyst says changes the outlook for Fauji Cement in the medium to long term.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'HUBC BYD EPS Scenario | PPL Receivables | Midday Flash 10 Nov 2026' (YouTube, 2026-11-10)

fact_text: The analyst expects Fauji Cement EPS of around 5 to 6 rupees to start improving in coming years, with a higher dividend possible.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'HUBC BYD EPS Scenario | PPL Receivables | Midday Flash 10 Nov 2026' (YouTube, 2026-11-10)

fact_text: Fauji Cement paid two dividends a year 10 to 15 years ago, but the practice was dropped after the 2016 silo collapse event.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'HUBC BYD EPS Scenario | PPL Receivables | Midday Flash 10 Nov 2026' (YouTube, 2026-11-10)

fact_text: Fauji Cement's German-technology plant has run at utilisation levels above 100 percent, while Chinese-built plants rarely exceed 80 to 85 percent even at peak.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'HUBC BYD EPS Scenario | PPL Receivables | Midday Flash 10 Nov 2026' (YouTube, 2026-11-10)
